prompt.text: A contractor badge is on the bench by the gates. The photo is face down. The gates are in their night schedule.

choices.label: Use it to get back upstairs
choices.debrief: A found badge is not yours, even for one floor.
choices.report: You badged through on someone else's card.
choices.voice_line: You used a badge you found. The gates will show the wrong person.

fallout.text: The contractor reports the badge lost. The log shows it was used after they left the building.

choices.label: Take it to the security desk
choices.debrief: Security can kill the badge. The bench cannot.
choices.report: The found badge went to the security desk.
choices.voice_line: You took the found badge to the security desk.

choices.label: Leave it where it is
choices.debrief: The next person through the lobby can pick it up.
choices.report: The badge is still on the bench.
choices.voice_line: You left the badge on the bench.

fallout.text: A visitor picks it up and walks in behind a tenant.

draft_note: Control IDs reviewed by Claude: training controls as on Monday, plus PR.AA-06 for physical access where it applies.
